Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Scandinavia with a ridge to the west of the British Isles.


##Wind##

East or northeast 2 to 4 at first, imminently becoming variable 3 or less.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain becoming scattered this morning, then isolated later today.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in places.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mostly variable 3 or less, then becoming mainly east or southeast 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mostly slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate in places.
